name: loop_map
description: Cyclic-conflict map for TC-3 and the Appendix C proof. A triangle of three single-lane junction-to-junction edges, each junction carrying one spur. Placing robots on S0/S1/S2 with goals S1/S2/S0 creates a three-way cyclic wait: each robot needs the segment the next one is about to occupy. The total order on (priority, robot_id) must yield exactly one robot proceeding, with no cycle able to form.
